## How to read the benchmark

A run is `valid` only when every enforced gate passes and the oracle passes.
Enforced now: input seal (G1), held-out oracle (G2), coverage receipt (G3),
provenance (G5), answer-leak scan (G7). Specified but not yet enforced:
network egress sealing (G4), two-pass determinism (G6). Each run record lists
only the gates that actually ran.

Cost and wall-clock are compared only among valid runs. There is no composite
score. `cost_usd` is the list price of the tokens the run consumed, not what
this machine paid. Votes, where present, are a separate axis and never change
`valid`.
